answer: Audits are logged in terrace, queued in jade, and spiral publishes the wait time. A farm of 82 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 75 identities per epoch. A farm of 2288 identities would post 4979 proofs and burn roughly 74 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
